# Local Evals

> Run an MCPJam eval suite file on your machine with mcpjam test with local results and an MCP

Jam identity

> [!NOTE]
>
> The upcoming SDK 10, CLI 6, and Vitest 0.3 releases require an MCPJam login or `sk_` API key for e
very eval, including BYOK runs with uploads disabled. These versions must ship after the backend run-start endpoint is deployed. E
arlier versions keep their existing behavior.\n\n`mcpjam test <file>` runs an MCPJam suite file locally: it connects your MCP serv
ers, drives each case's prompts through a model, grades the transcript with the same assertions a hosted run uses, and decides the
run with the same verdict policy. Bring your own provider key and authenticate the run with MCPJam. With MCPJam-hosted inference
it uses your existing CLI login and billing.\n\nResults are **never uploaded**. The command writes results to your terminal and, i
f you ask, to a report file. It records the run start with MCPJam. Like every command, it sends the CLI's single anonymous [teleme
try](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/telemetry.md) event, which `--no-telemetry` or `DO_NOT_TRACK=1` turns off; the run adds no teleme

try of its own.

## Eval identity and local data

Run `mcpjam cloud login` locally, or set `MCPJAM_API_KEY` to an organization
`sk_` key in CI. The SDK also accepts `apiKey` or `mcpjamAuth` in run options. Explicit credentials take precedence over `MCPJAM_
API_KEY`, which takes precedence over the saved CLI login. An invalid explicit credential never falls back to another account. CI
never starts an interactive login. Ask an organization admin for a key if you cannot create one.\n\nEvery logical run needs an onl
ine start response. MCPJam retries transient failures within ten seconds, then stops before execution. A prior successful run does
not enable offline execution. The CLI resolves the project using its existing `--project`, environment, and linked-project settin
gs; a key can only access its own organization.\n\nWith results uploads disabled, the start-run request sends only the credential
in the authorization header, any MCPJam API headers you configure through the SDK's `inference.resolveMcpjam`, project selection,
a new run-start ID, client version and surface (SDK, CLI, or Vitest), planned iteration count, provider names, and whether a clien
t profile is used (`unknown` for custom executors). The server resolves the organization and account. The start-run request sends
no prompts, outputs, tool calls, or server URLs. MCPJam-hosted inference still sends prompts through MCPJam to the model, as befor
e. Retries reuse the same ID. Planned iterations are intent, not completed usage or a charge. This release adds no debit, quota dr
aw, or balance refusal.\n\n`DO_NOT_TRACK`, `MCPJAM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED`, and CLI telemetry settings disable analytics, not the requ

ired run-start request. Results remain local unless result uploading is enabled separately.

## Quick start

### 1. Write a su

ite

Save this as `.mcpjam/evals/example.yaml`:

```yaml theme={"theme":"css-variables"}
schemaVersion: "2"
mode: agen

tWorkflow
reportingMode: standard
suite:
 id: s_notes_example
 name: Notes server
target:
 servers:
 - name: notes
d

efaults:
 judge:
 enabled: false
 model: anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5
 iterations: 1
 passThreshold: 1
 validity: {}

cases:
 - id: c_reads_a_note
 title: reads the note it was asked about
 steps:
 - id: s1
 kind: prompt

prompt: What does note 7 say?
 - id: a1
 kind: assert
 assertion:
 type: toolCalledAtLeastOn

ce
 toolName: read_note
 - id: c_never_deletes
 title: never deletes when only asked to read
 steps:
 -

id: s1
 kind: prompt
 prompt: Summarize note 7.
 - id: a1
 kind: assert
 assertion:

type: toolNeverCalled
 toolName: delete_note
```

`mcpjam cloud eval validate --file .mcpjam/evals/example.yaml` c

hecks the file offline, with no account.

### 2. Configure the server

`mcpjam test` binds each `target.servers[].name` to a l

ocal MCP config. The simplest is a `.mcp.json` next to where you run the command:

```json theme={"theme":"css-variables"}

variables"}
export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=[REDACTED]
mcpjam test .mcpjam/evals/example.yaml
```
